purpose: Prepare the join between independent research returns and the Reader Edition without duplicating the 30-job research batch.
transform: Match each return to its original job_id and stable paragraph_id.
Admit only VERIFIED_READER_AID with a verified verification passport and non-empty reader-facing text.
Route RECAST back to research with the missing evidence.
Reject duplicate returns and cross-marriage to the wrong paragraph/job.
invariant: Reader support may attach to the working edition, but source text mutation remains forbidden.
